b2add26dad0a99e62868.en: The Disease Control Agency (hereinafter referred to as CDC) announced on October 1, 2026 that one new case of local dengue fever was added to Changhua County. For men in their 60s living in Changhua County, Changhua County, fever, diarrhea, general weakness, and other symptoms have appeared since the end of September. After returning home, they went to the hospital again because the symptoms did not improve. After reporting and testing, they were diagnosed with dengue fever, and the first type of dengue virus was detected. The case is currently hospitalized, and there are no suspected symptoms in close contacts. The CDC explained that the main place of activity during the incubation period of the case is the residence of Changhua County and the workplace of the county and city outside Changhua County. There is no history of foreign travel. After the investigation, the residence of the case is about 110 meters away from the residence of the first local type of dengue fever case in Changhua County announced by the CDC on September 18. It is preliminarily judged as a community cluster event. It is the first local dengue fever cluster in Changhua County since 2023 and will be further sequenced.

aa484fb10934585a78a9.en: Newtalk News French student demonstrations continue to burn. Paris police chief Patrice Faure said on the 3rd that the student protest movement spreading across the country is now out of control, and he strongly called on protesters to return to peaceful action and solemnly reminded all circles that the authorities will not tolerate any violence and vandalism and will respond strongly. According to Reuters, the student demonstration, which was triggered by old classrooms, inadequate funding and lack of educational resources, has rapidly burned down since it broke out on September 28 and has further escalated into violent clashes. About 5,000 people have been arrested across the country, most of them teenagers, and dozens have been injured.
